status: reviewed by the maintainer on 4 November 2026
description: Retrieval benchmark for the Nigeria Tax Act 2025 (as enacted; commencement 1 January 2026). Each query names the one section or schedule that best answers it; Recall@10 is measured against this release's own retrieval documents. Queries mix everyday and legal wording and were checked against the approved text on 4 November 2026.

queries.query: What is the purpose of the Nigeria Tax Act 2025?
Is income from crypto or digital assets taxable in Nigeria?
queries.note: s.4(1)(j) profits or gains from transactions in digital assets.

queries.query: I live in Nigeria but earn money from abroad, do I pay tax on it here?
queries.note: s.12 resident individual taxed on worldwide income.

queries.query: Is my salary and bonus taxable as employment income?
Are company car and housing provided by my employer taxable?
Does a foreign company pay tax on profits from Nigerian customers?
What business expenses can a company deduct before paying tax?
Which expenses are not deductible for income tax?
Can I claim rent relief on my personal income tax?
queries.note: s.30(2)(a)(vi) rent relief of 20%, up to ₦500,000.

queries.query: How are small traders without proper records taxed?
Do I pay capital gains tax when I sell my house?
queries.note: s.51 principal private residence exemption, once in a lifetime.

queries.query: Is selling my private car subject to capital gains tax?
queries.note: s.53 private motor vehicles, up to two a year.

queries.query: Do I pay tax on land my father gave me as a gift?
How is chargeable gain on selling shares or property calculated?
What is the company income tax rate under the new tax law?
What is the minimum effective tax rate for large companies?
How much personal income tax do I pay on my salary?
queries.note: s.58 rates for individuals in the Fourth Schedule.

queries.query: What is the 4% development levy on companies?
queries.note: s.59 development levy and its distribution.

queries.query: How are insurance companies taxed?
Do I get relief if my foreign income was already taxed in another country?
queries.note: s.119 unilateral relief, foreign tax credit.

queries.query: How soon must a document be stamped after signing?
Do I pay stamp duty on my house rent agreement?
queries.note: s.134 leases; exemption below ₦10,000,000 annual value.

queries.query: What is the stamp duty rate on buying land or a house?
queries.note: Ninth Schedule table, conveyance on sale 1.5%.

queries.query: What is the current VAT rate in Nigeria?
Who must collect and remit VAT on goods sold?
queries.note: s.153 collection of VAT by taxable person.

queries.query: What must a VAT invoice contain?
Is there a surcharge on petrol and diesel?
queries.note: s.158 surcharge of 5% on fossil fuel products.

queries.query: Are basic food items and medicines charged VAT?
queries.note: s.186 zero-rated supplies (basic food, medical products, educational books).

queries.query: Which goods and services are exempt from VAT?
Are donations to charity deductible from my taxable income?
Which businesses can get the economic development tax incentive?
queries.note: s.165 priority sectors in the Tenth Schedule.

queries.query: What tax credit does a priority company get under the economic development incentive?
Must transactions between related companies be at arm's length?
queries.note: s.191 related-party transactions at arm's length.

queries.query: Which old tax laws did the Nigeria Tax Act repeal?
queries.note: s.195 repeals (CITA, PITA, VAT Act, Stamp Duties Act and others).
